subject: reasoning
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting second to the right of D. A is sitting second to the right of B. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is to the immediate right of A?
solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

B is sitting second to the right of D.

A is sitting second to the right of B.

C is not an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/474862828fee5df76b01a8da508d20b0676c3f6ba1837337da369eccddb294c4.png] 

Here, the person sitting to the immediate right of A is D.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
